messages:
Maria: Quick heads-up — GreenLeaf Health is ready to sign the PO but legal returned an MSA with redlines around audit/KMS and a DPA tweak. They also want confirmation of signer path (procurement vs engineering exec) and whether SSO will be enforced for the billing contact. Can legal + procurement + solutions weigh in?

Tom: Thanks — can you paste the exact redline snippets? biggest ask I saw was a tighter audit window and they want the KMS key usage to be documented. I can propose language to limit audit scope to logs relevant to the customer account.

Maria: Pasted the two short excerpts from their counsel: 
```
Section 9.2: "Customer may audit Redwood systems upon 10 days' notice, with no more than 2 audits per year."
Section 12.1: "KMS: Customer requires control of keys for data at rest; provider must allow key rotation by customer."
```
They highlighted both as blockers for procurement.

Sunil: Audit frequency is the usual sticking point. We can accept 1 audit/year scoped to a SOC report and specific buckets. For KMS, we need to know if this is HSM-backed customer-managed keys or just a policy statement. Ask them to confirm requirement is BYOK (bring-your-own-key) vs. provider-rotated keys.

Priya: On the POC side — GreenLeaf expects the final eval by EOW next week. They want the dedicated test instance isolated and a short list of test prompts (we already shared). If Legal needs logs for the audit clause, we can offer redacted access to request traces for the PO timeframe.

Tom: Draft proposal from legal: 
```
- Audit: Customer may request one onsite or remote review per 12 months limited to records and logs pertaining to the Customer's account; Redwood will coordinate and redact unrelated data.
- KMS: Redwood will support customer-managed keys in our Private offering (VPC/on-prem) and will document key usage; for Hosted API, we offer provider-managed keys with rotation and strict access controls.
```
Is that an acceptable compromise?

Maria: Sounds good — GreenLeaf prefers Hosted but might accept Private for KMS. They asked if choosing Private changes pricing and onboarding timeline. Also: billing contact needs SSO enforced (IdP) for portal access and they want the PO to reference net45 payment terms.

Sunil: Net45 is OK but need procurement PO scan and vendor info. Pricing: Private deployment adds a platform fee and estimated 2–4 week onboarding. I'll prep an estimated amendment to the orderform with delta costs.

Priya: App note: If they go Private for BYOK, we need at least one week lead time for cert/key exchange and a short security questionnaire (they asked for our completed SCC/ISO snapshot). I can attach the SOC/ISO pack and the POC runbook.

Maria: On signatures: who signs the MSA vs the PO? Customer legal says MSA must be signed by their GC; PO by procurement. They want signature routing to include countersign by our finance lead and an exec for credit limits. @signature-bot, can we create a routing flow for this customer? :slightly_smiling_face:

signature-bot: Created routing template "greenleaf-multisig-v1" — route order form to Sunil -> Finance (Elena) -> Exec (CEO) for counter-sign. MSA route: Tom -> Counsel -> Exec. Link: https://signing.redwood/internal/flows/greenleaf-multisig-v1

Tom: I'll prepare tracked-change MSA with the proposed audit + KMS language and loop in counsel for counterparty acceptance. Maria, please confirm which deployment they prefer (Hosted vs Private) so I can finalize the order form clause set.

Maria: I asked them; they prefer Hosted initially but will escalate to Private if we can't support BYOK. I'll push for Hosted + provider-managed keys and confirm net45 PO.

Sunil: I'll draft the PO amendment showing net45, billing contact SSO requirement, and the delta pricing for Private vs Hosted. Sending draft in this thread shortly.

Priya: I'll upload SOC/ISO docs and the POC runbook to the shared folder and ping GreenLeaf. If Legal greenlights the compromise language, we should be able to sign next week.

Maria: Perfect — thank you all. I'll update the customer and post the signed PO when it comes in. :thumbsup:
